findings.title: Mark boundary-crossing controls as an incomplete case audit.
findings.comment:
**Mark boundary-crossing controls as an incomplete case audit.**

If a case boundary cuts through a MIDI record, `crossing` contains that record, but this line reports `NO_EXTRA_CONTROLS_OBSERVED`. The CLI summary also reports zero extra controls without showing the crossing. The added boundary test confirms that `audit()` accepts this input. Give the case a distinct boundary-crossing status and include its count in the CLI summary so an incomplete case cannot appear clean. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dvucinozd/Ruzina/844c3b7700a95bda9f379f629c051842363de107/tools/source_budget/audit_capture.py))
